response.text:
I can’t truthfully say “I’m working on it” or continue work overnight — I don’t have the contracts and I can’t run background or delayed tasks without an automation tool. However I can help immediately so you’re ready to proceed as soon as the contracts are available.

What I can do now (pick any):
- Draft a detailed project plan & timeline for comparing 300 contracts.
- Build a comparison template/spreadsheet with suggested columns (key clauses, dates, parties, obligations, risks, flags).
- List the exact inputs I’ll need (file formats, sample contracts, whether redactions are needed).
- Propose an extraction approach (manual review checklist vs. semi-automated NLP pipeline) and tooling recommendations.
- Provide a ballpark effort estimate and resource options (single reviewer, small team, or automation).

Quick ballpark (very approximate — I’ll refine with samples):
- If manual review averages ~30 minutes/contract → ~150 reviewer-hours (about 19 full workdays for one reviewer).  
- With automation-assisted extraction, upfront setup may take a few days and could reduce manual review time dramatically.

Questions to confirm before I prepare the plan/template:
1. Do you have sample contracts (format, typical length)?  
2. Which clauses/fields must be compared (must-have vs. nice-to-have)?  
3. Any deadline or delivery format required?  
4. Do you prefer a manual, automated, or hybrid approach?

Tell me which deliverable(s) above you want now and answer the questions you can — I’ll prepare the plan and template immediately.
